newsitem.title: USA: Oakland, Calif. airport sets record cargo volume.
newsitem.headline: Oakland, Calif. airport sets record cargo volume.

text.p: Oakland International Airport said Wednesday it handled record volumes of passengers and cargo in the fiscal year ended June 30.
Nearly 10 million passengers transited the Oakland airport between July 1, 1995 and June 30, 1996, an increase of seven percent over the previous fiscal year, the airport said.
Cargo grew from 515,059 tons to 576,977 tons, an increase of 12 percent, the airport said.

"We are seeing continued growth in passenger activity at the start of the new fiscal year," said Director of Aviation Steve Grossman. He added that cargo should continue to grow during fiscal year 1996-1997.
